<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs=""
>
[Clinging to Life](/Feats.aspx?ID=5260) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 80

**Frequency**
once per day

**Trigger**
You’re reduced to 0 hit points and don’t immediately die.

</column>

---

This life still holds much for you, and you aren't ready to fall back into the River of Souls just yet. When you're reduced to 0 Hit Points and not immediately killed, you go to 1 Hit Point instead, fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88), and are [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95), and you don't gain the [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=99) condition.
